1_definitions.POC: Point of Control (auto-printed from a fixed-range volume profile, per period).
1_definitions.VAH: Value Area High — Farouk says 'very high'.
1_definitions.VAL: Value Area Low — Farouk says 'very low'.
1_definitions.SFP: Swing Fail Pattern — wick through a swing, NO candle close, then reverse; 'prints a dot line'.
1_definitions.liquidity_sweep: market makers sweep a liquidity pool (equal highs/lows) then reverse.

rules.2_value_area_basis: FIXED-RANGE volume profile per PERIOD: daily, 3-day, 5-day, weekly, 2-week, monthly (auto-plotted). NOT session/visible-range.
rules.3_poc_T_variants: NOT explained in Part Two -> still UNKNOWN (unchanged from FP-INDICATOR-001).
rules.4_usage: Below VAL=bearish (retest=short); reclaim VAH=bullish; TARGET = next POC ('long until the next weekly POC'); SCALE between POCs (5D/3D/VAH/VAL). Trapped-traders = swept-high SFP. 'Go heavy on gold, make $200-300, log out' (scalp).
rules.5_sfp_sequence: prior swing high/low -> wick through (no candle close) -> close back inside -> prints a DOT / dot-line marker -> RETEST -> confirm (combine with volume candles = high sell/buy pressure; or box candle-close) -> TARGET (reversal) -> INVALIDATION (fails to break / reclaims and pushes through).
rules.6_distinctions: PARTIAL. SFP and liquidity sweep are closely related (both sweeps of a level); the box CANDLE-CLOSE breakdown is a distinct concept. Farouk says 'combine, not one thing'. CHoCH/MSS/BOS NOT cleanly separated here (only 'break of structure' mentioned in Part Three). Distinctions loosely defined.
rules.7_ownership: 'The POC indicator' = [kyle] v1. SFP + liquidity sweeps + EMAs also v1.
rules.9_repaint_intrabar_close_alert: SFP uses 'no candle close' (closed-bar reasoning); repaint / dot-print timing / alerts NOT stated -> UNKNOWN.
rules.author_note: 'Carl said you need to put it [the EMAs]' -> author handle ~ 'kyle'/'Carl'. Farouk: 'I never use the EMAs.'
